name: harness-marketplace
description: Governed harness engineering for AI agents: scaffold, audit, verify and red-team, on any framework.

plugins.name: harness-core
plugins.description: Resume and checkpoint skills, a Haiku explore agent, a Sonnet verifier, and a hook that shows only failing test output.

plugins.name: harness-init
plugins.description: Scaffold a harness into any repo: work list with done_when and evidence, progress note, decisions log, clean-state checklist, init.sh, guard script, CLAUDE.md and safe settings.

plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Score a repo's agent harness across 7 areas (instructions, state, verification, scope, safety, evals and red team, cost and context), with evidence for every pass and a fix for every gap.

plugins.name: harness-redteam
plugins.description: Set up behaviour evals and a red team for your agent with promptfoo and DeepTeam, mapped to OWASP LLM and agentic risk lists.
